priorityList.notes: Arcane Power on cooldown: a flat 30 percent damage cooldown with no cast time of its own.
Presence of Mind on cooldown: free (no GCD) and makes the next cast instant.
Missile Barrage is the talent proc that empowers your next Arcane Missiles cast -- fire the empowered Missiles under it, where the Arcane guide places the payoff.

Arcane Blast until it carries 3 stacks, then Frostbolt: each stack adds damage and 175% to the next Arcane Blast's cost, and with one Missile Barrage proc giving one free Arcane Missiles, three stacks measured ahead of two and of four.

Frostbolt is the filler once two Blasts are up: a cheaper, faster cast than Arcane Missiles that still enjoys the Blast buff on your other spells and still has a 20% chance to proc Missile Barrage. Casting it ends the Blast buff, which is the point - the next Blast starts a fresh, cheap pair. Before Arcane Blast is learned, Arcane Missiles spam is the whole rotation.

Shoot only when nothing else can be cast, which in practice means out of mana: a wand shot cannot start during the global cooldown and holds you for the wand's full speed, so it never fits between spells.
